title: Task list page with add form
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-01-task-basics.md → 'On screen → / the task list' (the add form, the open list, the Done section, empty state, counts), 'App (src/app/)', 'Documentation added → how/tasks.md'. Read it first, plus .tick/learnings.md.

Existing on this branch: src/lib/db (getDb(), DatabaseSync type via `import type { DatabaseSync } from "@/lib/db"`), src/lib/tasks (Task, TaskInput, parseTaskInput, formDataToRaw, listTasks/getTask/createTask/updateTask/setDone/deleteTask taking db first). This is Next.js 16 App Router: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for server actions, useActionState, revalidatePath, and `"use client"` rules before writing; the AGENTS.md block warns that APIs differ from older Next.

Deliver:
- src/app/page.tsx (server component): `const { open, done } = listTasks(getDb())`; renders `<AddTaskForm />` then `<TaskList open={open} done={done} />`. Headings "Open (N)" and "Done (N)" as h2; the Done section omitted when done is empty; empty state paragraph "No tasks yet. Add the first one above." when both are empty. Set `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"` so the page always reads the database.
- src/app/actions.ts (`"use server"`): `addTask(prevState: AddTaskState, formData: FormData): Promise<AddTaskState>` where `AddTaskState = { errors?: { title?: string; notes?: string }; values?: { title: string; notes: string }; ok?: boolean }`: parseTaskInput(formDataToRaw(formData)); on error return { errors, values: {title, notes as submitted strings} }; on success createTask(getDb(), value), revalidatePath("/"), return { ok: true }. Also export `toggleTask(formData)` and `removeTask(formData)` as stubs? NO: leave them to the next tick; export only addTask here.
- src/app/components/add-task-form.tsx (`"use client"`): useActionState(addTask, {}); a form with label "Title" + input name="title" (placeholder "What needs doing?", defaultValue from state.values?.title), label "Notes" + textarea name="notes", button "Add task"; error text under each field rendered from state.errors with role="alert"; the form uses a `key` that changes on success (e.g. a counter in state or `state.ok ? Date.now() : 0`) so inputs clear after a successful add. Keep the form usable without JS: it is a plain <form action={formAction}>.
- src/app/components/task-list.tsx (server component): renders the open list (ul, each li: a disabled-looking checkbox placeholder is NOT required yet; render the title, the first line of notes in muted text if notes non-empty, and an "Edit" link to `/tasks/${id}/edit`). Do not add done/delete controls (next tick). Render the Done section with struck-through titles (line-through class).
- e2e/tasks.spec.ts: tests "shows the empty state on a fresh database", "adds a task and shows it first under Open (1) with the form cleared", "rejects an empty title with 'Title is required.' and adds nothing". Each test must start from a known state: since the e2e database persists across tests within a run, make each test independent by using unique titles and asserting relative changes; for the empty-state test, add `test.beforeAll` that deletes `data/e2e.db*` is NOT possible while the server runs, so instead: in playwright.config.ts set `env.DATABASE_PATH` to a fresh path per run, e.g. `data/e2e-${Date.now()}.db` computed in the config (keep the data/.gitignore pattern *.db so they stay untracked), and order the empty-state test first in the file with `test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" })`. Note: e2e runs post-merge by the orchestrator; you do NOT run pnpm test:e2e in the worktree. Write it carefully; use getByRole/getByLabel/getByText.
- src/app/components/add-task-form.test.tsx (jsdom): renders labels "Title" and "Notes" and the "Add task" button; shows the error text when the action state carries errors (mock the server action module with vi.mock("../actions") returning a state with errors and assert the alert text). Keep it small.
- Docs: create docs/current/how/tasks.md (tier 2): intro paragraph; `![Task flow](../diagrams/task-flow.svg)` then `<!-- diagram: task-flow -->` above a Mermaid sequence or flowchart: form submit → server action → formDataToRaw → parseTaskInput → (errors: re-render with values) / (ok: repository call with getDb()) → revalidatePath("/") → page re-reads listTasks; `## Key entry points` table (page, action, components, repository, validation, with exact paths and exports); mechanism prose with the exact validation messages, ordering rules and the "force-dynamic" fact; a failure-modes table (e.g. stale list without revalidatePath, client component importing server-only code). Add it to _overview.md (Documents + Diagrams `task-flow`) and README.md's document map; refresh the last-update line. Update docs/current/README.md "What it is" only if a fact changed. Run pnpm docs:check.
- Remove the placeholder text in page.tsx from the scaffold; keep the layout.
Files likely touched: src/app/page.tsx, src/app/actions.ts (new), src/app/components/*.tsx (new), e2e/tasks.spec.ts (new), e2e/smoke.spec.ts (update the heading assertion if the h1 changes: keep an h1 "harness-demo" in the layout header or page), playwright.config.ts, docs/current/how/tasks.md (new), docs/current/_overview.md, docs/current/README.md.
Run in-worktree: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
